name: AirTag
note: Apple suggests a bitterant-coated CR2032 whose packaging says it is compatible with AirTag, and notes that some bitterant-coated CR2032 batteries might not work with it.

source.title: How to replace the battery in your AirTag
source.quote: Insert a new CR2032 lithium 3V coin battery (available at most electronic and drug stores) with the positive side facing up.
